_about: The reference install's plugins brought across whole (the owner 2026-10-10): krew-complete-probe, the reference's kanban_task_completed spike observer, shipped and enabled on no profile (as the reference). The other plugins this pass touched (krew-kanban-lean, krew-docs, krew-render, krew-board, krew-comfy) keep their files and their entries in config/krew-packages.json.

krew-complete-probe.about: A spike probe: one JSON line per kanban_task_completed hook fire under $KREW_HOME/spikes/kanban-complete-hook (KREW_KANBAN_HOOK_SPIKE_DIR). Observer only; enabled nowhere by default.
